summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute large obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) probes for the Bun runtime and, if absent, downloads a platform-specific Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts and chmods the binary into a temp directory, then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the bundled sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-only script (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that is heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW`), a large numeric index array (`n7gIxM`), and hex-mangled identifiers throughout, so its behavior cannot be inspected statically. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly fetched alternate JavaScript runtime bypasses Node-based scanners and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The advertised purpose of the package is a React UI component library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second JS runtime and run an obfuscated sibling at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
